description: This file contains cryptographic big number (BIGNUM) modular exponentiation functions, including BN_mod_exp and its variants, used for cryptographic calculations in OpenSSL.

methods.name: BN_mod_mul
methods.description: Performs modular multiplication of two BIGNUMs with a modulus, using BN_CTX for temporary variables.

methods.name: BN_mod_exp
methods.description: Performs modular exponentiation of a BIGNUM base raised to an exponent, modulo a modulus, selecting optimized implementation based on compile-time conditions.

methods.name: BN_mod_exp_recp
methods.description: Performs modular exponentiation using reciprocal multiplication method, optimized for certain conditions.

methods.name: BN_mod_exp_simple
methods.description: Performs modular exponentiation using a simple square-and-multiply algorithm as fallback.
